_doc: OPTIMIZER POOL — single source of truth for per-(contract,chain) optimizer settings, artifacts, and codehashes. Run deploy/sync_optimizer_pool.sh to compile each contract under its profile and fill init_codehash / deployed_codehash / runtime_bytes. RULE: a codehash-pattern factory (PossessioFactory) pins a template's init_codehash IMMUTABLY at deploy — so a template's optimizer setting is FROZEN once its factory is live. Change a setting -> re-sync -> the codehash changes -> you must re-pin it (which means a new factory). Never desync by hand; this file is the truth.

hot.for: small + called constantly — cheap runtime forever

l1.for: Ethereum L1 — balance expensive deploy vs expensive runtime

contracts.name: PossessioSaltPool
contracts.reason: deployed once, rarely called — deploy size over runtime

contracts.name: PossessioHook
contracts.reason: near the 24KB EIP-170 wall — runs=1 is REQUIRED to fit, not a cost choice. Eats slightly pricier swaps forever as the cost of being feature-complete.

contracts.name: STEEL
contracts.reason: lives in the same file as the hook — one compilation unit, so it shares runs=1. Could be split to a hot profile if transfer-gas ever matters more than a shared build.

contracts.name: PossessioPool
contracts.role: pool template — CONFIRM: is this the template PossessioFactory deploys?
contracts.reason: if it is the factory's template, its init_codehash is what gets pinned into PossessioFactory.templateCodehash — freeze this setting BEFORE deploying the factory

contracts.name: PossessioFactory
contracts.reason: rarely called; its OWN optimizer is independent of the templates it deploys. It validates a template's init_codehash — that hash is immutable once this factory is constructed.

contracts.name: PossessioPayments
contracts.reason: hit on every payment — optimize runtime; small enough to fit at high runs

contracts.name: PossessioX402Core
contracts.reason: called per-trade — cheaper execution compounds over volume

contracts.name: PossessioWhiskyMarket
contracts.reason: auction/settlement, moderate call frequency — start at default, revisit to hot once live if bid gas matters

contracts.name: L1AnchorFactory
contracts.reason: uses `new L1Anchor(...)` — L1Anchor's bytecode is compiled INTO this contract, so both share this setting. Expensive L1 favors a moderate balance.

contracts.name: L1Anchor
contracts.reason: WELDED to L1AnchorFactory (embedded new) — cannot take a different optimizer than its factory. Setting shown for reference; it is not independently deployable at another runs.
